headlines.title: DoorDash to acquire Instacart in $17bn deal
headlines.summary: Under the transaction, Instacart shareholders are to receive $65 per share.

headlines.title: Zohran Mamdani Says $17 Billion Instacart Takeover Means ‘Higher Prices and Harsher Exploitation,’ DoorDash CEO Says It’ll Make Delivery Cheaper
headlines.summary: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani said Thursday that DoorDash Inc.‘s (NASDAQ:DASH) $17 billion deal to buy Instacart will raise prices for the city, but the company’s CEO Tony Xu said it will make delivery faster and more affordable. Mamdani Objects to DoorDash-Instacart Deal On Thursday, DoorDash agreed to acquire Maplebear Inc. (NASDAQ:CART), which does business as Instacart, for $65 per share, a 26% premium to its Oct. 22 close.

headlines.title: DoorDash: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
headlines.summary: The company is betting reinvestment in product and logistics will unlock long-term returns before profit extraction accelerates.

headlines.title: DoorDash CEO Says $17B Instacart Deal Will Make Grocery Delivery Faster And Cheaper; FTC Scrutiny Looms
headlines.summary: DoorDash executives believe the company’s planned $17 billion Instacart acquisition could boost grocery delivery and expand advertising revenue.

description: DoorDash, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a commerce platform that connects merchants, consumers, and dashers in the United States and internationally. The company operates DoorDash Marketplace, Wolt Marketplace, and Deliveroo Marketplace, which provide various services, such as customer acquisition, demand generation, order fulfillment, merchandising, payment processing, and customer support. It also offers consumer membership programs, DashPass, Wolt+, and Deliveroo Plus; advertising as a value-added service through its marketplaces; and white-label delivery fulfillment services, as well as services that help merchants establish online ordering, build branded mobile apps, manage reservations and in-store dining, manage consumer relationships, enable tableside order and pay, and improve customer support. The company was formerly known as Palo Alto Delivery Inc. and changed its name to DoorDash, Inc. in 2015. DoorDash, Inc. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
